Model: Red Bull RB18 F1 2022 Car
Source: FetchCFD project 2999
Project URL: https://fetchcfd.com/threeDViewGltf/2999-red-bull-rb18-f1-2022-car-3d-model
Direct GLB: https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/fetchcfd/original/file-1667386677367.glb
Original creator credited by source page: SRT Performance / TheRealSRT (Sketchfab)
The FetchCFD page describes the model as free for download and for CFD/rendering use. Verify the source page's current terms before any public redistribution.
HDRI: Poly Haven Venice Sunset 1K (CC0)
Clarity note: source RB18 GLB embeds 512-level base-color atlases. Viewer uses 2K PMREM HDR, anisotropic filtering, procedural carbon normal detail, and true 3840x2160 capture mode.
Super-resolution pass: embedded base-color atlases were reconstructed with an FSRCNN x4 model and resized to a maximum 2048-pixel dimension before being re-embedded. This improves edge continuity and close-view sharpness, but does not create new physically measured source detail.
